Our jobs aren’t just about giving guests a smooth check-in and check-out. Instead, we want to build and experience that is memorable and unique. Our Guest Experience Experts take the initiative to deliver a wide range of services that guide guests through their entire stay. They are empowered to move about their space and do what needs to be done. Whether processing operational needs, addressing guest requests, completing reports, or sharing the highlights of the local area, the Guest Experience Expert makes transactions feel like part of the experience.

No matter what position you are in, there are a few things that are critical to success – creating a safe work place, following company policies and procedures, maintaining confidentiality, protecting company assets, upholding quality standards, and ensuring your uniform, personal appearance, and communications are professional. Guest Experience Experts will be on their feet and moving around (stand, sit, or walk for an extended time) and taking a hands-on approach to work (move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 10 pounds without assistance). Doing all these things well (and other reasonable job duties as requested) is critical for Guest Experience Experts – to get it right for our guests and our business each and every time.

d: From high-octane lobby socialising to events, celebrations, and business conclaves, every venue pulses to the electric Mondrian beat. With food and nightlife venues spread across eight different locations on the property, there is nothing like Mondrian Doha in the entire region.
We are looking for a People, Culture & Development Manager to oversee day-to-day People & Culture operations and lead Learning & Development across Mondrian Doha.

Reporting to the Director of People & Culture, you will guide department leaders on people matters, support the team member experience from recruitment through offboarding, and lead the hotel’s learning agenda. You will turn service priorities, performance feedback and team development needs into practical training that makes a difference on the floor.
q: Experience in a People & Culture or HR generalist role, with hands-on responsibility for designing and delivering Learning & Development programmes.
Experience coaching leaders and handling employee relations matters with sound judgment and discretion.
Strong facilitation skills and the ability to adapt training for frontline teams, supervisors and managers.
Confidence using HR and learning management systems and translating data into clear actions.
Strong written and spoken English and the ability to work effectively with a multicultural team.
A degree or diploma in Human Resources, Hospitality Management, Business Administration or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
Experience in a luxury or lifestyle hotel and familiarity with Qatar Labour Law are preferred.

d: The Project Manager – Water (PMC) is responsible for overseeing and managing all water-related project activities on behalf of the Project Management Consultant (PMC) to ensure successful project delivery. The role involves coordinating with clients, consultants, contractors, utility providers, and key stakeholders to ensure water infrastructure works are executed in accordance with project requirements, quality standards, contractual obligations, budget, and schedule. The Project Manager – Water will provide technical leadership, monitor project performance, manage risks, and ensure compliance with local regulations, environmental requirements, and industry best practices throughout the project lifecycle.
Lead and manage all water infrastructure project activities from design review through construction, testing, commissioning, and project handover.
Review and monitor water design deliverables, drawings, specifications, hydraulic calculations, and engineering submissions.
Ensure water infrastructure works comply with project requirements, local authority regulations, utility provider standards, and international best practices.
Oversee contractor performance and monitor construction progress against approved schedules, milestones, and project objectives.
Review and approve shop drawings, material submittals, method statements, RFIs, and technical submissions related to water networks and associated systems.
Coordinate interfaces between water infrastructure, roads, utilities, drainage, structures, buildings, and other multidisciplinary project elements.
Conduct regular site inspections to verify quality, safety, and compliance with approved designs, standards, and specifications.
Monitor project risks and develop mitigation strategies to minimize impacts on cost, quality, schedule, and operational performance.
Facilitate coordination meetings with contractors, consultants, clients, utility authorities, government agencies, and stakeholders.
Evaluate variations, claims, and change requests related to water systems and provide technical and commercial recommendations.
Track project KPIs, progress reports, and performance metrics for management and client review.
Ensure successful completion of testing, commissioning, performance verification, and handover requirements.
Support procurement activities, including technical evaluations, vendor assessments, and contractor selection processes.
Drive resolution of technical, operational, and commercial issues affecting project delivery.
Ensure compliance with health, safety, environmental, sustainability, and quality management requirements.
Lead, mentor, and supervise water engineers, inspectors, and project teams to achieve project objectives.
q: Engineering Degree in an appropriate discipline, preferably Civil Engineering.
Licensed / Registered with a recognized professional authority.
At least 10 years of relevant experience in water and wastewater infrastructure projects.
Strong exposure to water and wastewater systems.
Bid and proposal management for water/wastewater opportunities
Experience delivering and/or managing major municipal water and wastewater projects.
Familiarity with international standards and client requirements in the Middle East region.
Proven track record of leading successful water/wastewater bids and proposals.
Professional registration such as PE, CEng, PMP, or equivalent would be advantageous

d: The Project Manager is responsible for planning, executing, monitoring, and delivering projects within the approved scope, timeline, and budget. The role requires working primarily on-site to oversee daily project activities, supervise progress, coordinate with site teams, contractors, consultants, and other stakeholders, and ensure that all work is carried out according to approved plans, specifications, safety standards, and quality requirements. The Project Manager is also responsible for managing project resources, monitoring schedules and costs, identifying and resolving site-related issues, preparing progress reports, and ensuring timely project completion while maintaining effective communication and coordination throughout the project lifecycle.
q: Minimum of 10 years of experience in project management, preferably in construction and architectural projects.
Proven experience managing and supervising projects on-site from initiation to completion.
Strong knowledge of construction processes, architectural drawings, technical specifications, and project execution.
Experience in project planning, scheduling, budgeting, cost control, and resource management.
Ability to coordinate effectively with contractors, consultants, subcontractors, and site teams.
Fluency in English; Arabic is an advantage.
